state_of_the_art.statement: Enumerating all 1023 nonempty subsets of {1, ..., 10} (scripts/check_state_of_the_art.py) shows that every residue modulo 101 is a sum of inverses of distinct denominators. One residue needs 5 terms, so the minimum possible longest row is 5. Shparlinski's theorem answers the asymptotic question (Erdős Problem #1180).
